title: How Much Do Large Language Model Cheat on Evaluation? Benchmarking Overestimation under the One-Time-Pad-Based Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the variance in model performance across private benchmarks from different academic domains (e.g., Math, Economics, Physics, Biology) using a novel metric called the Rugged Score (RS_II) to quantify unbalanced training that targets specific evaluation domains.
